requirements.title: Accept IMU Samples
requirements.description: The nav library shall accept IMU samples containing accelerometer and gyroscope measurements via its public API.
requirements.rationale: FT1 nav estimation derived from SW-REQ-SYS-002 requires IMU input as the primary propagation source.

requirements.title: Accept GPS Measurements
requirements.description: The nav library shall accept GPS position measurements via its public API.
requirements.rationale: FT1 nav estimation per SW-REQ-SYS-002 requires GPS input to bound horizontal position.

requirements.title: Accept Barometric Altimeter Measurements
requirements.description: The nav library shall accept barometric altimeter measurements via its public API.
requirements.rationale: FT1 nav estimation per SW-REQ-SYS-002 requires baro input to constrain vertical state.

requirements.title: Sixteen-State Nav Estimate Output
requirements.description: The nav library shall output a sixteen-state estimate of position, velocity, attitude quaternion, accelerometer bias, and gyroscope bias.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-013 nav state composition into the library-level output contract.

requirements.title: Nav Estimate Available at 100 Hz
requirements.description: The nav library shall make an updated nav estimate available to the caller at 100 Hz.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-012 publish rate into the library-level production cadence.

requirements.title: Geodetic Position Output
requirements.description: The nav library shall output position as WGS-84 geodetic latitude and longitude in degrees with altitude in meters.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-038 geodetic frame into the library-level position output contract.

requirements.title: HAE Altitude Reference
requirements.description: The nav library shall reference output altitude to the WGS-84 ellipsoid.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-039 HAE convention into the library-level altitude output contract.

requirements.title: NED Velocity Output
requirements.description: The nav library shall output velocity in the North-East-Down frame.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-040 NED velocity convention into the library-level output contract.

requirements.title: Body-to-NED Quaternion Output
requirements.description: The nav library shall output attitude as a unit quaternion rotating from body frame to NED.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-041 attitude representation into the nav library output contract.

requirements.title: SI Units for Nav Outputs
requirements.description: The nav library shall express all nav estimate quantities in SI units.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-042 SI-units mandate into the library-level output contract.

requirements.title: Nav Validity Flag Output
requirements.description: The nav library shall output a validity flag indicating whether the current nav estimate is trustworthy.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-015 validity flag into the library-level output contract.

requirements.title: Validity False on Missing Inputs
requirements.description: The nav library shall set the validity flag false when required nav inputs are unavailable.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-059 validity behavior into the library-level observable contract.

requirements.title: Continued Propagation With Reduced Inputs
requirements.description: The nav library shall continue producing a nav estimate when GPS or baro inputs are unavailable.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-034 degraded-input continuation into the library-level behavior.

requirements.title: Bounded Position Divergence From GPS
requirements.description: The nav library shall keep its horizontal position output within a configured distance of the latest GPS fix.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-014 divergence sanity bound into the library-level observable contract.

requirements.title: Deterministic Nav Output
requirements.description: The nav library shall produce identical nav estimates given identical input measurement sequences.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-044 determinism into the library-level reproducibility contract.

requirements.title: POSIX and Pico2 Functional Equivalence
requirements.description: The nav library POSIX build shall produce nav estimates functionally equivalent to its Pico2 build.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-043 POSIX equivalence so Trick simulation exercises the same nav behavior as flight.

requirements.title: Body Axes Convention for IMU Inputs
requirements.description: The nav library shall treat IMU body-frame inputs as X-forward, Y-right, Z-down.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-057 body axes convention into the nav library input interpretation contract.

requirements.title: EKF Filter Algorithm
requirements.description: The nav library shall use an Extended Kalman Filter to estimate the navigation state vector.
requirements.rationale: PM-pinned filter choice (2026-05-03); EKF balances FT1 nonlinear dynamics with kmat-implementable Jacobians and bounded WCET on Pico2.

requirements.title: Configurable Noise Covariance Loading
requirements.description: The nav library shall accept caller-supplied noise covariance values via NAV_INIT_T at initialization.
requirements.rationale: PM directive 2026-05-03: all noise/covariance values must be load-time configurable to enable per-build tuning without recompilation; the design provides reference values as installation guidance only.

requirements.title: Configurable Initial State Covariance Loading
requirements.description: The nav library shall accept caller-supplied initial state covariance values via NAV_INIT_T at initialization.
requirements.rationale: Closes implementation-readiness gap G2 from 2026-05-03 SSE-R re-review: P_0 (initial state covariance) governs how quickly the filter trusts measurements relative to the seed; same load-time-configurable philosophy as SW-REQ-NAV-019 (noise covariance) per PM directive 2026-05-03. Without this, two implementers could choose P_0=0 (locks state at seed) or P_0=large (accepts all measurements) producing radically different startup behavior.
